mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_table_config (database_type, table_name, visible, custom_comment) VALUES (#{databaseType}, #{tableName}, #{visible}, #{customComment}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE visible = VALUES(visible), custom_comment = VALUES(custom_comment)

INSERT INTO schema_field_config (database_type, table_name, field_name, visible, custom_comment) VALUES (#{databaseType}, #{tableName}, #{fieldName}, #{visible}, #{customComment}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE visible = VALUES(visible), custom_comment = VALUES(custom_comment)
